lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: Lady Renoux. Forgive me, I'd rather finish this chapter than pretend to care about the seating arrangements — sit, please, if you don't mind an unfashionable dinner companion.

choices.text: "An old philosophy — the kind that questions the Lord Ruler's histories."
"Nothing you'd expect a Venture heir to bother with."
"Whatever it is, it seems to matter more to you than this table does."

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: You noticed that without me saying it outright. Most nobles I dine with wouldn't. I find I'm curious what else you notice, Lady Renoux.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: Fair enough. Most of court would say the same, and mean it as an insult. You didn't, quite.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: Careful — say things like that at Kredik Shaw and people will start expecting honesty out of you.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: In any case. Stay as long as you like, my lady. The wine's better than the conversation usually deserves.
